text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali tells Prime Minister Karoui to promote consumption of locally made products.
- President receives report from Central Bank Governor Hamda on economic results during first quarter of 1997; exports and tourism did well.
- Committees discuss final draft of ninth development plan. for 1997-2001.
- Consultations with political parties and professionnal organisations start over final draft of development plan.
- President tells prime minister to chair Saturday meeting of high planning committee for approval of final draft of development plan.
